title: Ram Kumar v. State of U.P.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Abhinava Upadhya, J. and Shamim Ahmed, J.
disposition: Writ disposed; relegated to Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 with two-month stay of recovery.
headnote: A writ challenging a recovery citation of Rs.70,030, in which the petitioner denied being a consumer, was disposed of by directing a detailed representation to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, to be decided in accordance with law within two months, with coercive action on the citation stayed for that period.
facts: Ram Kumar petitioned the Allahabad High Court against a recovery citation dated 14 October 2019 for Rs.70,030, asserting that he was not even a consumer of electricity under the Electricity Act. Counsel for the distribution licensee submitted that the controversy concerned the amount of the bill and could be examined by the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: billing dispute — representation to Executive Engineer
holding_units.holding: Where a writ challenges a recovery citation and the licensee characterises the controversy as a dispute about the amount of the bill, the High Court will relegate the petitioner to a detailed representation before the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005, to be decided in accordance with law within two months, and will stay coercive action on the citation for that period.

principle_tags.application: The Court treated a recovery-citation dispute over bill amount as a matter for representation to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 rather than decision on the writ.
The writ was disposed of by directing a Clause 6.5 representation, without a merits grant or refusal on the demand.
The submission that the bill-amount dispute can be dealt with by the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 was adopted as the disposal path.

not_decided.point: Whether the petitioner is a consumer of electricity under the Electricity Act
not_decided.note: The petitioner's denial of consumer status was recorded but not adjudicated.

not_decided.point: Correctness of the recovery citation dated 14.10.2019 for Rs.70,030
not_decided.note: Left to the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5.
